name: Local JSON Queries
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Select Copy JSON to copy the complete result, including rows the table display omits.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Local JSON Queries is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for querying your JSON files with it.
